thread:
maria: FYI customer report — enterprise tenant A: intermittent GitHub SSO failures, ~1 in 5 logins. UI shows 'state mismatch' after redirect. Happening across Chrome + Safari on mobile.
tonY: Thanks. Any reproducible steps or headers we can inspect?
maria: Repro steps customer provided:
  1) Click 'Sign in with GitHub' from app
  2) Redirect to github.com/... with state=LONG_BASE64
  3) GitHub redirects back to https://corp.app/callback?code=...&state=TRUNCATED_OR_MISSING
  4) App errors with "state mismatch". They captured redirect headers.
ashley: Can you paste the raw redirect response/set-cookie header? suspect cookie split.
maria: Paste from their network trace (redacted):

```
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://corp.app/callback?code=abc123&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9... (cut)
Set-Cookie: session=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdGF0ZSI6Imxvbmcgc3RhdGUiLCJwcm...; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None
```
Their proxy/edge shows the header being split into two Set-Cookie lines — second chunk never reaches browser (edge drops after 4096 bytes). Result: session cookie missing state payload.
tonY: @tony checking our edge logs for that tenant now.
ashley: We also see PKCE logs in our auth service showing code_verifier missing for those requests: `pkce: verifier not found for session id=null` — because session cookie not present.
ashley: TL;DR: state lives inside JWT session cookie, cookie is >4kb so proxy/chunking causes header truncation and user returns without session -> state mismatch.
maria: Customer says this started after they enabled our new CDN fronting their callback domain last week.
devops-bot: Deploy 2026-03-10T22:11:14: edge-proxy v2.4.9 rollout updated header buffer/strip rules for long headers.
tonY: Found tenant-specific route hitting legacy loadbalancer which has header size 4096 limit and stripped subsequent Set-Cookie headers. Confirmed in LB logs: repeated Set-Cookie header count >1 removed.
ashley: Short-term mitigation options:
  - issue a hotfix: move state to query param + encrypted short token (smaller) or reduce cookie payload.
  - disable CDN header strip for callback path (config change) — quick rollback.
  - recommend customer use hosted callback domain (our domain) to avoid their CDN rules.
maria: Customer prefers quick fix on our side. Can infra flip the LB rule on callback path to allow multiple Set-Cookie headers? Also need to notify security about cookie size tradeoffs.
tonY: I'll open infra ticket and schedule a config rollback. If we can reproduce, we can patch our auth service to use compact state (base62 short id) as fallback.
ashley: I'll add a guard: if session missing at callback, persist the incoming state param into a short temporary store and correlate on subsequent requests for 30s. Ugly but buys time.
maria: Action items:
  - @tony open infra/edge ticket, priority P1, revert header-stripping for /callback for affected tenant (ETA 2h)
  - @ashley implement short-term state-backstop in auth (PR + rollback plan)
  - @maria coordinate with customer + provide workaround (use incognito? sometimes works if cookie chunk arrives)
  - notify security and infra about cookie size risk
devops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-8921: "edge LB drops extra Set-Cookie -> OAuth state lost" assigned to eng-infra, priority P1.
tonY: Assigned to myself, starting investigation. Will post logs and a repro link here in 30m.
maria: Thanks — please add any reproducible curl or proxy config so we can share with customer. :thumbsup:
